Definition: Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king
BiblicalUsage: Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)"; 1) ruler of Israel, son of Ahab; 2) ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)
